comment: The delay lines are 32 samples deep (PreciseDelay.cpp:34-39) and all sixteen channels are copied every sample whether or not the input carries them, with the output channel count taken from the input at lines 102-107. No family is given to any of these jacks: they carry whatever is patched into them, so no colour would be true of them. The read index is (write pointer + 33 - delay) modulo 32, so a setting of 1 is a one-sample delay.
